rationale: OMH is an extremely low-float (~2.13M shares) micro-cap that has already experienced a massive multi-day range ($19.91 to $94.60 today alone), with the current price at only 28% of today's range and well below both VWAP ($50.22) and the 9-EMA ($48.06), suggesting the momentum has reversed sharply from the highs. The bid-ask spread of 184 bps on a stock with this volatility profile (ATR ~$8.14 on 5-minute bars) makes any directional trade extremely costly to enter and exit, and the last five 1-minute candles show erratic, choppy price action with no clean directional structure. With 87 minutes to close, no news catalyst, and today's realized loss already at -$145.50, the risk/reward of engaging this chaotic, illiquid instrument does not justify a position.
